recovery_login.subject: Yaşam Sistemi — someone signed in to your account with a recovery code
lines: Someone signed in to your account using a recovery code. The code that was used is no longer valid.
If you have lost your phone, revoke the lost device under Settings › My Sign-in Methods and create new recovery codes.
If this sign-in was not you, change your password immediately and inform your system administrator.

owner_offline_login.subject: Yaşam Sistemi — an Owner offline recovery code was used
lines: Someone signed in to the Owner account with a code from the offline recovery kit. All other sessions of the account have been closed.
If this was not you, the kit has been compromised: generate a new kit from the SQL console and change your password.

recovery_codes_generated.subject: Yaşam Sistemi — your recovery codes have been renewed
lines: New recovery codes have been created for your account. Your previous codes are no longer valid.
The codes are not included in this message; they were shown only once, on the screen where they were created.
If this was not you, change your password immediately and inform your system administrator.

email_changed_old.subject: Yaşam Sistemi — your account email address has been changed
lines: The sign-in email address of your account has been changed. This address is no longer linked to your account.
If you did not make this change, contact your system administrator immediately.

email_changed_new.subject: Yaşam Sistemi — your email address has been verified
lines: This address has been verified as the sign-in email address of your Yaşam Sistemi account.

recovery_case_opened.subject: Yaşam Sistemi — an account recovery request has been opened for you
lines: Your system administrator has opened an account recovery request, reporting that access to your account was lost.
For your security, the request can be processed no earlier than 72 hours from now.
If you did not ask for this, sign in to your account and cancel the request under Settings › My Sign-in Methods.

recovery_case_executed.subject: Yaşam Sistemi — account recovery completed
lines: The recovery of your account has been completed: registered devices have been revoked and open sessions have been closed.
When signing in, use the single-use recovery ticket your system administrator gave you.
If you did not ask for this, contact your system administrator immediately.
